verdict.rationale: Chronicle Labs is an agent simulation and evaluation platform. It records an agent's instructions, model, and tools when you register a version, but only so you can compare versions in tests. Nothing in the evidence shows it storing prompts as managed artifacts or pushing prompt changes to production without a code deploy. The vague 'autonomous fix and rollback' claim for production agents is an adjacent feature, not prompt deployment.

support.subject: As a developer, I can version prompts and deploy changes to production without shipping code
